bloc.L’eau compte à deux titres, et c’est le: Water counts in two ways, and it is the heart of the module: cooling water, which operators publish and the Regulation requires — and source water, consumed upstream to produce the electricity purchased, which the WUE does not count and which weighs, on the national estates where both terms are published, eight to twelve times more.
